verdict.rationale: YPOG's own insight briefings cover German employee equity: ESOP taxation under the Future Financing Act and Section 19a, plus profit participation rights as an alternative to VSOPs. This shows the firm works with German ESOP and VSOP schemes, but no service page states that it designs option plans. Missing for 10: an explicit service page for designing employee equity or option plans, any coverage of UK EMI or Indian ESOPs and other non-German schemes, and independent corroboration of plan-design work.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: changes the framework conditions for the taxation of Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs) for start-ups
Section 19a GITA enables start-ups to offer their employees equity participations either free of charge or at a discount
offer a more favorable taxation scheme compared to participants in virtual share option programs (VSOPs)
